name: agentic-dev-workflows
description: Cross-cutting workflows for developing software with AI agents, on any platform or stack: take in voice notes, screenshots (incl. Google Photos albums) and screen recordings to steer the work, decompose a narrated sprint into tracked bugs, features, docs and ideas, review the running UI for a focus such as simplification, resolve a UI friction point by options-then-build, set and pin a release pattern, and find complementary plugins.
